name: train30_4b
notes: TRAIN30 / DEV31 / TEST60 (dataset version agentclinic_main_v2_train30). Experiment matrix of the main table and the component ablation. One Agent backbone (Qwen3-4B), Doctor google/gemma-3-12b-it. Every trained condition is an independent run from the same pretrained model: three SERL iterations (run iteration index 0, 1, 2 = table column Iter 1, 2, 3), the same TRAIN cases, protocol, Effectiveness model, GRPO settings, training samples and seeds; only reward.weights and the rubric schedule differ (allowed_differences). No condition's checkpoint initializes another. Tables are filled from DEV until the final evaluation; TEST is not read here.
seeds_status: OPEN DECISION: the number of training seeds

evaluation.rollouts_status: OPEN DECISION: natural collaborations per case and checkpoint (same for every condition)
evaluation.final_split_notes: opened once, after every setting is frozen; not produced by this code without --allow-test
evaluation.appropriateness_status: OPEN DECISION: the behavior-appropriateness column needs one definition that is the same for every condition (conditions have different rubric sets). Candidates: the RQ2 state-based behavior judge (scripts/run_eval.py rq2-states; it reads the first Agent turn) or scoring every reached turn against one frozen reference rubric set. tables reads eval_dev/appropriateness.json {value} once a producer is chosen; until then the column is empty.
evaluation.effectiveness_status: OPEN DECISION: the effectiveness column. Candidates: mean calibrated delta of the frozen predictor over the reached turns of the evaluation collaborations, or matched continuations (K = 9, scripts/run_eval.py rq2-effectiveness). tables reads eval_dev/effectiveness.json {value}; it needs the predictor of this protocol, which does not exist yet.

static_rubric.label: Static Rubric + Effectiveness + Outcome
static_rubric.rubric_source: R_0 of the Ours run (base failures: validated, consolidated, effectiveness-gap filtered and weighted), unchanged in every iteration

no_filtering.label: No-filtering Rubric + Effectiveness + Outcome
no_filtering.rubric_source: every raw candidate of the failure analysis, iterations 0..i, no validation / consolidation / effectiveness filter

ours.label: Ours: Filtered/Evolving Rubric + Effectiveness + Outcome
ours.rubric_source: this iteration's failures only: candidates -> validation -> consolidation -> effectiveness-gap filter

minus_effectiveness.label: Ours - Effectiveness
minus_effectiveness.description: Ours - Effectiveness removes the direct effectiveness reward term while retaining effectiveness-gap-based rubric filtering and weighting.

rows.label: - Rubric
rows.reused_from: main table: Effectiveness + Outcome (same config and run)

rubric_behavior.failure_scores_status: OPEN DECISION: which scorer levels count as a behavior failure (0 only, or 0 and 1). The repository has no earlier binary definition: scores are used as 0 / 0.5 / 1. Every level's count is stored, so the table can be recomputed.
rubric_behavior.mismatch: score == fully_satisfied_score and Effectiveness delta < 0 (no epsilon: the repository defines none)
rubric_behavior.population: the sampled responses of the iteration's GRPO training (iter<i>/reward_log.jsonl), each scored on its own turn against the iteration's active rubrics

initial_rubrics_status: OPEN DECISION: every rubric-using condition takes its iteration-0 rubric step from the Ours run (same base failures -> same R_0 and the same raw candidates), instead of asking the rubric models again per run. Implemented as the default; leaving INITIAL_RUBRICS unset makes a run build its own.
no_filtering_weights_status: OPEN DECISION: weight of a raw rubric in the Weighted SoftMin. Implemented: 1 per candidate (each was written from one failure, so its failure frequency is 1), normalized over the applicable ones as in Ours.
rubric_method_status: OPEN DECISION: see rubric_registry.selection in the main config (population of the effectiveness gap; minimum support, now 1 per group, to be fixed from TRAIN support counts before the real rubrics, never from DEV or TEST; no cap).
minus_effectiveness_status: Displayed as 'Ours - Effectiveness'. It removes the direct effectiveness reward term (0.3 R_E) while retaining effectiveness-gap-based rubric filtering and weighting, so the rubric step still uses the predictor.
empty_rubric_set_status: OPEN DECISION: an iteration in which no rubric has a positive effectiveness gap trains with an empty rubric set (R_A unavailable for every response; the other weights are not rescaled). Implemented as that, with a warning in the iteration's summary.
scorer_audit_status: OPEN DECISION: size and auditor of the scorer validation sample (Jev against a human or an independent model on a stratified sample of scored responses). scripts/scorer_audit_sample.py draws the sample; no audit has been run.

research_questions.RQ1: collaborative task performance: the main table (task success of Baseline, Outcome, Effectiveness + Outcome, Static, No-filtering, Ours at Iter 1 / 2 / 3)
research_questions.RQ2: interaction behavior quality: behavior appropriateness, effectiveness, controlled evidence (separate evaluation; columns not defined yet)
research_questions.RQ3: why it works: Static vs Evolving, No-filtering, the component ablation, the rubric behavior analysis

scale_replication.plan: a larger Qwen backbone with Baseline and Ours only; it needs its own base collaborations, Effectiveness labels and predictor. It is not part of this matrix and shares nothing with it.
